For insurance contracts with direct participation
features, the variable fee approach applies.
The variable fee approach is a variation on the
general model. When applying the variable fee
approach, the entity’s share of the fair value
changes of the underlying items is included in
the contractual service margin. Consequently,
the fair value changes are not recognised in
profit or loss in the period in which they occur
but over the remaining life of the contract.
